summary:
Use the admitted prefix P and a fresh private directory W. These are source-supported proposals, not native qualification. Reuse the prior P2996 compiler contract for C++26, -freflection, -fno-blocks, arm64/macOS 27, explicit SDK/resource paths and private libc++ headers; no new compiler flag research is needed.

clang-format: feed the original bytes on stdin with --style=LLVM, --assume-filename=W/formatted.cpp and --fail-on-incomplete-format; capture stdout as the private formatted copy only after exit 0 and nonempty output. Omit -i. Stdin avoids the filename loop's .clang-format-ignore skip, and explicit style avoids ancestor style discovery. Feed that copy to the same stdin/style invocation with --dry-run --Werror. It returns 1 when replacements remain, 0 when none remain; read/style errors also fail. Important: the dry-run branch returns before the incomplete-format test, so put --fail-on-incomplete-format on the producing command. The formatter's LangOptions default Reflection to false and Latest maps to C++20; the fork lexer recognizes ^^ and [: :] as reflection tokens only with Reflection enabled. Thus successful formatting/idempotence is not proof of reflection correctness. No native corruption/failure is asserted here: preserve and compile the actual formatted output in the later fixture.

clangd: use an existing absolute --check=W/formatted.cpp and --compile-commands-dir=W, an exact one-entry compile_commands.json arguments array, and explicit --enable-config=false --background-index=false --clang-tidy=false --check-locations=false --check-completion=false. The check branch returns before LSP server startup. It still builds a memory preamble, AST, local FileIndex, inlay hints and semantic highlighting; this is deliberately narrower than default per-token editor-feature checks. Require exit 0, 'Compile command from CDB', the expected compiler/flags in its log, and 'All checks completed, 0 errors'; reject fallback/inferred commands. Check failures return 3; invalid file/path/options can return other nonzero codes. Warnings are not counted as errors. Leave query-driver globs absent and unset CLANGD_FLAGS, CLANGD_TRACE and CLANGD_METRICS. Empty globs disable compiler include extraction, but CommandMangler::detect still attempts macOS xcrun lookups. A clangd-only PATH pointing to an empty private directory prevents those lookups; keep absolute compiler/SDK/resource/include paths. This PATH control is source-derived and awaits runtime verification; a missing-xcrun log is expected. Do not apply that PATH to later compiler/link commands.

llvm-ar: with an absent private archive, use --format=darwin rcsD W/libreflection.a W/reflection.o, then t W/libreflection.a. r replaces/inserts, c suppresses the creation warning, s emits the index, D selects deterministic mode; omit thin mode. Normal archive members use object basenames and listing skips internal members, so require exactly 'reflection.o\n' and both exits 0. Read/write/parse/member errors fail with 1. Archive creation/listing does not prove an object is usable or that reflection survived formatting. The later parent fixture should link through this archive using the prior explicit private-runtime inputs, run the resulting witness, and validate its output/origins. That runtime work remains pending after task 07e.
